statement: A hub whose onward HTLC is refused fails the incoming lock back at once (outcome error, forward_failed:<reason>). The Quint cell holds the failback when the deadline arithmetic leaves no room to forward the lock (no-failback-when-tight); only that case carries the id there, and the outcome tag forward_failed:<reason> is not modelled.
